activity_summary: At the Bull, at three, the ostler counted sixteen days at twelvepence and argued a girth-gall as extra. You let the sixteen days stand and refused a penny beside them. You said horse, fodder and inns were about thirty-eight shillings, and that the sixteen sat inside that. The horse came off your hands.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Closed the hire at the sixteen days and took no new line.

facets.activity: Let sixteen days at twelvepence stand

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Sixteen days at twelvepence stands. The gall is the hire's own work.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The sixteen days are the charge. Nothing beside them.
